> Skip-the-line Louvre Pyramid timed-entry tickets with a multilingual audio guide. Instant confirmation and mobile tickets.

- Brand: Day Tour Paris
- Destination: Louvre Museum, Paris, France
- Price: from €32 per person

## Topics covered

- Louvre Pyramid skip-the-line / timed entry tickets
- Multilingual audio guide on mobile
- Mona Lisa, Venus de Milo, Denon / Sully / Richelieu wings
- Meeting point: Louvre Pyramid, Rue de Rivoli, 75001 Paris
- Instant confirmation, mobile ticket, policy shown before payment

## Frequently asked

- Does this ticket skip the line? Reserved timed entry at the Pyramid avoids the longest general queues; security screening still applies.
- Where is the meeting point? Louvre Pyramid main entrance, Rue de Rivoli, 75001 Paris — arrive 10–15 minutes early.
- Is the Mona Lisa included? The audio route covers Denon Wing highlights including the Mona Lisa.
- Is the ticket mobile? Yes — instant confirmation with a mobile ticket and phone audio guide.
